description_en: Creates a subtask to customize operations reports. After the customization, you can view the customized report data
description_zh: 调用CreateCdnSubTask定制运营报表，定制后可查看定制报表数据
name: CreateCdnSubTask

parameters.help_en:
The list of report IDs that support customization. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). Valid values:
1: Popular URLs (sorted by request count).
3: Popular URLs (sorted by traffic).
5: Popular Referers (sorted by request count).
7: Popular Referers (sorted by traffic).
9: Popular origin fetch URLs (sorted by request count).
11: Popular origin fetch URLs (sorted by traffic).
13: Top client IP addresses (sorted by request count).
15: Top client IP addresses (sorted by traffic).
17: Domain name ranking (sorted by traffic).
19: PVs and UVs.
21: Region distribution.
23: ISP distribution
parameters.help_zh:
支持定制的报表ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。取值：
1：热门URL（按请求数排序）。
3：热门URL（按流量排序）。
5：热门Referer（按请求数排序）。
7：热门Referer（按流量排序）。
9：回源热门URL（按请求数排序）。
11：回源热门URL（按流量排序）。
13：Top客户端IP（按请求数排序）。
15：Top客户端IP（按流量排序）。
17：域名排行（按流量排序）。
19：PV和UV。
21：访问区域分布。
23：运营商分布
parameters.name: report_ids

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The list of domain names to subscribe to. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).</props>

<props="intl">The list of domain names to subscribe to. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).</props>
If you do not specify this parameter, the report delivery task is subscribed to for all domain names under your account by default
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔</props>

<props="intl">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔</props>
不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名订阅报表交付任务
parameters.name: domain_name
